# GrowthBook/Focus Lab Connect (Lyndsie Berens)
Date: 2026-10-07 | Duration: 38.400001525878906m

## Summary
Growth Book is defining a brand that combines developer-first credibility, enterprise appeal, and a distinctive playful personality. The team wants clearer voice and tone guidelines because current messaging varies between humorous and dry styles, while mascot and logo usage remains inconsistent. The red panda should differentiate Growth Book from competitors, but its role, design variations, and boundaries need clarification before wider adoption. Messaging must address engineers, product managers, data scientists, and heads of experimentation while balancing product-centric language with market appeal. The team aims to identify a unifying brand truth centered on democratizing experimentation and enabling faster learning. Discovery will examine refresh versus rebrand decisions, clarify what brand elements are essential, gather internal and customer perspectives, and define project scope. The initial discovery phase lasts two weeks, followed by collaborative planning, voice and tone work, and potential design execution. Stakeholder input, including an interview with co-founder Jeremy, marketing perspectives, existing interviews, and podcast content, will inform the recommendations.

## Keywords
Brand Strategy, Mascot Usage, Voice and Tone, Customer Segmentation, Discovery Phase, Internal Alignment

Follow up with contract/legal team regarding SOW questions to expedite signing process (28:26)
Coordinate Basecamp and Slack invites and prep work delivery to Growth Book team before project kickoff (37:00)

Review and listen to selected Growth Book podcast episodes provided by Ashley for customer insights ahead of discovery (36:00)
